query:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS "Runs",
  COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Balls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_out_id = T2.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dismissals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fours",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sixes",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'R Shepherd%' AND T1.over_number >= 18 AND NOT (
    T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL
  );

query:
SELECT
  "striker",
  CASE
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' THEN 'Hyderabad'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Capitals' THEN 'Delhi'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Punjab Kings' THEN 'Punjab'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Pune Warriors'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiants' THEN 'Pune'
    ELSE "bowling_team"
  END AS Opponent,
  SUM("runs_scored") AS TotalRuns
FROM "Deliveries"
GROUP BY
  "striker",
  Opponent
HAVING
  SUM("runs_scored") >= 1000
ORDER BY
  TotalRuns DESC;

query:
WITH TeamScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)
SELECT
  T1."batting_team" AS "Team1",
  T1.total_runs AS "Team1_Score",
  T2."batting_team" AS "Team2",
  T2.total_runs AS "Team2_Score"
FROM "Matches" AS M
JOIN TeamScores AS T1
  ON M."match_id" = T1."match_id" AND M."team1" = T1."batting_team"
JOIN TeamScores AS T2
  ON M."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND M."team2" = T2."batting_team"
WHERE
  M."city" = 'Ahmedabad' AND M."match_winner" = 'Mumbai Indians';

SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS "number_of_sixes"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."batting_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') AND T1."runs_scored" = 6
GROUP BY
  T2."season",
  T3."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "number_of_sixes" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (T1.toss_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'bat') OR (T1.toss_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'field')
    THEN 'Batting First'
    ELSE 'Fielding First'
  END AS "MI_Action",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "Matches_Played",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Wins",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Losses"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
WHERE
  (T1.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' OR T1.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians') AND T1.stage <> 'Group'
GROUP BY
  "MI_Action";

query:
SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / 6.0 AS "Overs Bowled",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1."delivery_id"), 0) AS "Economy Rate",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Average",
  CAST(COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
    END
  ), 0) AS "Strike Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T3."player_name" = 'JJ Bumrah' AND T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."over_number" BETWEEN 6 AND 14;

query:
WITH PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  p."player_name",
  COUNT(ps."striker_id") AS "num_25_plus_scores"
FROM PlayerScores AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p
  ON ps."striker_id" = p."player_id"
WHERE
  ps."total_runs" >= 25
GROUP BY
  p."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_25_plus_scores" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning
), Opening_Batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id,
    non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    over_number = 0 AND ball_number = 1
)
SELECT
  p1.player_name AS "Batsman 1",
  p2.player_name AS "Batsman 2",
  op.partnership_runs AS "Partnership Runs",
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS "Opponent",
  m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Opening_Partnerships AS op
INNER JOIN Opening_Batsmen AS ob
  ON op.match_id = ob.match_id AND op.inning = ob.inning
INNER JOIN Matches AS m
  ON op.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p1
  ON ob.striker_id = p1.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p2
  ON ob.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH MI_Playoff_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."inning" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1

), First_Wicket_Partnerships AS (

)

  T2.first_wicket_runs
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN First_Wicket_Partnerships AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T2.first_wicket_runs >= 80
ORDER BY
  T2.first_wicket_runs DESC

query:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."batting_team",
    T1."striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."batting_team" ORDER BY T1.first_ball_faced) AS batting_position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_ball_faced
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id"
  ) AS T1
), MatchTop3Lineup AS (
  SELECT
    M."season",
    B."batting_team",
    GROUP_CONCAT(B."striker_id" ORDER BY B.batting_position) AS top_3_batters
  FROM BattingOrder AS B
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON B.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE
    B.batting_position <= 3 AND M."stage" = 'Group'
  GROUP BY
    M."season",
    B.match_id,
    B."batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT(B."striker_id") = 3
)
SELECT
  "season",
  "batting_team"
FROM MatchTop3Lineup
GROUP BY
  "season",
  "batting_team"
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT top_3_batters) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
  "season" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH PunjabDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."over_number",
    T1."ball_number",
    T1."runs_scored",
    T1."extra_runs",
    T1."player_out_id"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."batting_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
), RunningTotals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "running_score",
    COUNT("player_out_id") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_fallen"
  FROM PunjabDeliveries
)
SELECT
  MIN("running_score")
FROM RunningTotals
WHERE
  "wickets_fallen" = 5;

query:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"
FROM KohliMatchRuns AS T1, KohliDismissals AS T2;

SELECT
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "Runs",

WITH BattingOrder AS (

    "match_id",

    "striker_id",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS batting_position
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",

), PlayerScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",

)

FROM BattingOrder AS T1

INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3

WHERE
  T1.inning = 2 AND T1.batting_position >= 6 AND T2.batting_team = T4.match_winner

query:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

  T2."season",

    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1

GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";

SELECT
  T1."season",
  T1."venue",
  T2.inning1_score + 1 AS target,
  T1."match_winner" AS chasing_team
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning1_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY

) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS inning2_score
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
) AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."city" = 'Jaipur' AND T2.inning1_score >= 199 AND T3.inning2_score > T2.inning1_score;

query:
WITH PlayerMatchDates AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."team_name",
    T2."match_date"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "team_name",
    "match_date",
    LEAD("match_date", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "team_name" ORDER BY "match_date") AS "next_match_date"
  FROM PlayerMatchDates
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T1."team_name",
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(T2."match_id")
    FROM "Matches" AS T2
    WHERE
      (
        T2."team1" = T1."team_name" OR T2."team2" = T1."team_name"
      )
      AND T2."match_date" > T1."match_date"
      AND T2."match_date" < T1."next_match_date"
  ) AS "missed_matches"
FROM PlayerConsecutiveAppearances AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."next_match_date" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  "missed_matches" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

query:
WITH PartnershipData AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants'
), PartnershipPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group,
    MIN("striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id") AS p2_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM PartnershipData
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T3."player_name",
  T1.partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipPairs AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1.p1_id = T2."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1.p2_id = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.wicket_group >= 1
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

query:
WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty
  WHERE
    "balls_taken" <= 25
), SeasonCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "num_fast_fifties"
  FROM FastFifties
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "season"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."season",
  T1."num_fast_fifties"
FROM SeasonCounts AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."num_fast_fifties" DESC
LIMIT 3;

query:
WITH "PlayerRuns" AS (
  SELECT
    T2."season",
    T1."striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T2."season",
    T1."striker_id"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
)
SELECT
  "season",
  COUNT("striker_id") AS "num_players"
FROM "PlayerRuns"
GROUP BY
  "season"
ORDER BY
  "num_players" DESC
LIMIT 1;

query:
WITH Inning1Scores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "inning1_total"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
), ChasingTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1.match_winner IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1.match_winner
  END AS "team_name",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "successful_chases"
FROM Matches AS T1
JOIN Inning1Scores AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
JOIN ChasingTeams AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T1.match_winner = T3.batting_team AND T2.inning1_total >= 199
GROUP BY
  "team_name"
ORDER BY
  "successful_chases" DESC;

query:
WITH CumulativeStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT ("extra_runs" > 0 AND "runs_scored" = 0 AND "wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), InningsFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50"
  FROM CumulativeStats
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  COUNT(T1."striker_id") AS "fast_fifties_count"
FROM InningsFifty AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."balls_to_reach_50" < 20
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "fast_fifties_count" DESC
LIMIT 4;

query:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1

query:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'
          ) OR (
            T3."team1" = 'Gujarat Titans' AND (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
          )
        )
      GROUP BY
        T1."match_id"
      HAVING
        SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 100
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_faced",
  MAX("cumulative_runs_scored") AS "runs_scored"
FROM PlayerInnings
WHERE
  "cumulative_balls_faced" > 0
GROUP BY
  ("cumulative_balls_faced" - 1) / 20
ORDER BY
  "balls_faced";

query:
WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)
    FROM SeasonDefeats
  )
ORDER BY
  "season";

query:
SELECT
  m.season,
  CASE
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN d.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE d.batting_team
  END AS franchise,
  SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / COUNT(
    CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END
  ) AS run_rate
FROM Deliveries AS d
JOIN Matches AS m
  ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE
  d.over_number <= 5
GROUP BY
  m.season,
  franchise
ORDER BY
  run_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

query:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

query:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS "final_total"
FROM QualifyingInnings AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH FirstInningScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS first_inning_total
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' THEN CASE
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team2" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team2"
    END
    ELSE CASE
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team1" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team1"
    END
  END AS opponent_team,
  T2.first_inning_total + 1 AS target,
  T1."season"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FirstInningScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."match_winner" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND T1."result_type" = 'wickets' AND T2.first_inning_total >= 179;

query:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT

  T1."powerplay_runs",
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = T2."team1"
    THEN T2."team2"

) AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2

WHERE
  T1."match_id" IN (
    SELECT
      "match_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      MAX("over_number") >= 19
  )
ORDER BY
  T1."powerplay_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;

WITH DebutInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM DebutInnings AS T1
JOIN Deliveries AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" AND T1."debut_match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Players AS T3

GROUP BY
  T1."player_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

query:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T1."match_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."player_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date") AS rn
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BattingStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS player_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
    SUM("runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."team1" || ' vs ' || T3."team2" AS teams,
  T2.player_score,
  T2.balls_faced,
  T3."season"
FROM DebutMatches AS T1
JOIN BattingStats AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1 AND T2.balls_faced >= 10
ORDER BY
  T2.strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH DebutInning AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("match_date") AS debut_date
  FROM "Deliveries"
  JOIN "Matches"
    ON "Deliveries"."match_id" = "Matches"."match_id"
  GROUP BY

)

  SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS runs,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",

FROM DebutInning AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"

JOIN "Players" AS T4

ORDER BY
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH RankedBalls AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."runs_scored",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."inning", T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS ball_faced_num
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."season" = '2025' AND T1."wides" = 0
), NoBoundaryInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  FROM RankedBalls
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    MAX(ball_faced_num) >= 20
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN ball_faced_num <= 20 AND "runs_scored" IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS score_in_match
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN NoBoundaryInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T4."player_name",
  T1."match_id"

query:
WITH OverCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "bowling_team",
    COUNT(*) AS balls_in_over
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number"
)
SELECT
  T1.balls_in_over,
  T3."player_name",
  T1."bowling_team",
  T2."season"
FROM OverCounts AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.balls_in_over = (
    SELECT
      MAX(balls_in_over)
    FROM OverCounts
  );

query:
SELECT
  T1."team1",
  T1."team2",
  T2."batting_team",
  T2.pp_runs || '/' || T2.pp_wickets AS powerplay_score,
  T1."city"
FROM Matches AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS pp_runs,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS pp_wickets
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T1."result_type" IN ('runs', 'wickets')
ORDER BY
  pp_runs ASC,
  pp_wickets DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH PlayerAppearances AS (
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  UNION
  SELECT
    "delivery_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FirstAppearance AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_delivery
  FROM PlayerAppearances
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), BattingPositions AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY first_delivery) AS position
  FROM FirstAppearance
), PlayerRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T3."total_runs",
  T5."venue",
  T5."match_date"
FROM BattingPositions AS T1
JOIN PlayerRuns AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."striker_id" AND T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T5
  ON T1."match_id" = T5."match_id"
WHERE
  T3."batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1."position" >= 5 AND T3."total_runs" >= 50
ORDER BY
  T3."total_runs" DESC;

query:
WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T1."streak_count",
  T1."scores",
  T1."teams",
  T1."years"
FROM StreakDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN MaxStreak AS T2
  ON T1."streak_count" = T2.max_streak
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."player_name";

query:
WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"
)
SELECT
  T1."partnership_runs",
  T2."batters"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN PartnershipBatters AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."partnership_group" = T2."partnership_group"
ORDER BY
  T1."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;

query:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

query:
WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date,
    SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

multilingual.punjabi: ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਧਾਰ 'ਤੇ 4000 ਰਨ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਵਾਲੇ 4 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼।

query:
WITH CumulativeData AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_balls"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), MilestoneReached AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("cumulative_balls") AS "balls_to_4000"
  FROM CumulativeData
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 4000
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."balls_to_4000"
FROM MilestoneReached AS T4
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T4."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."balls_to_4000"
LIMIT 4;

query:
WITH BatterScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 40
), InningsWith40Plus AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM BatterScores
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    COUNT("striker_id") >= 4
)
SELECT
  T2."season",
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team1" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team1"
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T2."team2" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T2."team2"
  END
FROM InningsWith40Plus AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id";

multilingual.hindi: IPL में लगातार सबसे ज़्यादा बार 25+ स्कोर बनाने वाले 5 खिलाड़ी और उनकी स्ट्रीक बताएं।
multilingual.telugu: IPL లో వరుసగా అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ సార్లు 25+ స్కోర్ చేసిన 5 క్రీడాకార్లు ఎవరు? పేరు మరియు స్ట్రీక్ రాయండి.
multilingual.punjabi: IPL ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ 25 ਜਾਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਦੇ 5 ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ; ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ streak ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿਓ ।

query:
WITH PlayerMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id" AS "player_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
), ScoresWithDate AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_date",
    CASE
      WHEN T1."runs" >= 25 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_25plus"
  FROM PlayerMatchRuns AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "is_25plus",
    (
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "is_25plus" ORDER BY "match_date")
    ) AS "streak_group"
  FROM ScoresWithDate
), StreakLengths AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  WHERE
    "is_25plus" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."streak"
FROM StreakLengths AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."streak" DESC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH HaulCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    COUNT(*) AS num_hauls
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "bowler_id"
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
      AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
    GROUP BY
      "bowler_id",
      "match_id"
    HAVING
      COUNT(*) >= 4
  )
  GROUP BY
    "bowler_id"
), RankedHauls AS (
  SELECT
    "bowler_id",
    "num_hauls",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "num_hauls" DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM HaulCounts
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."num_hauls"
FROM RankedHauls AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rnk <= 4
ORDER BY
  T1."num_hauls" DESC;

query:
WITH WicketDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    CASE
      WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
),
SequencedWickets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id",
    "is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev_is_wicket",
    LAG("is_wicket", 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "bowler_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "prev2_is_wicket"
  FROM WicketDeliveries
),
HatTricks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "bowler_id"
  FROM SequencedWickets
  WHERE "is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev_is_wicket" = 1 AND "prev2_is_wicket" = 1
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name"
FROM HatTricks AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."bowler_id" = T2."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
HAVING
  COUNT(T1."match_id") > 1
ORDER BY
  COUNT(T1."match_id") DESC
LIMIT 3;

query:
WITH FirstInningsScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") >= 200
), SecondInningsChase AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  M."team1",
  M."team2",
  M."city",
  SUBSTR(M."season", 1, 4) AS "year",
  (S."legal_balls" / 6) || '.' || (S."legal_balls" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM "Matches" AS M
JOIN "FirstInningsScores" AS F
  ON M."match_id" = F."match_id"
JOIN "SecondInningsChase" AS S
  ON M."match_id" = S."match_id"
WHERE
  M."match_winner" = (
    SELECT
      "batting_team"
    FROM "Deliveries" AS D
    WHERE
      D."match_id" = M."match_id" AND D."inning" = 2
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY
  S."legal_balls" ASC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS partnership_group_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM PartnershipDetails
  GROUP BY "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "non_striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
  )
),
FullPartnerships AS (
  SELECT
    pr."match_id",
    pr.total_runs,
    GROUP_CONCAT(p."player_name", ', ') AS players
  FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
  JOIN PartnershipPlayers AS pp
    ON pr."match_id" = pp."match_id"
    AND pr."inning" = pp."inning"
    AND pr."partnership_group_id" = pp."partnership_group_id"
  JOIN "Players" AS p
    ON pp.player_id = p."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    pr."match_id",
    pr."inning",
    pr."partnership_group_id",
    pr.total_runs
  HAVING COUNT(pp.player_id) >= 2
)
SELECT
  fp.total_runs AS "runs",
  fp.players AS "players_involved",
  CASE
    WHEN m."team1" = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN m."team2"
    ELSE m."team1"
  END AS "opposition",
  m."season" AS "year"
FROM FullPartnerships AS fp
JOIN "Matches" AS m
  ON fp."match_id" = m."match_id"
ORDER BY
  fp.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

query:
WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") AS total_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 100
), CumulativeInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings
  WHERE
    cumulative_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T2.total_runs,
  T1.balls_faced,
  T1."bowling_team",
  T3."city",
  T3."season"
FROM BallsTo100 AS T1
JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  T1.balls_faced ASC
LIMIT 4;

query:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "legal_deliveries_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
), FirstToHundred AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team",
    MIN("legal_deliveries_faced") AS "balls_to_100"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 100
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "bowling_team"
)
SELECT
  T2."bowling_team" AS "opposition",
  T3."season" AS "year",
  (T2."balls_to_100" / 6) || '.' || (T2."balls_to_100" % 6) AS "overs_taken"
FROM FirstToHundred AS T2
JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T2."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."balls_to_100" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("balls_to_100")
    FROM FirstToHundred
  );

query:
WITH PlayerAverages AS (
  SELECT
    T2."player_name",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS total_runs,
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS batting_average
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2
    ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team"
  HAVING
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 500
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."player_out_id" = T1."striker_id" AND T1."wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT
  "player_name",
  "bowling_team" AS "opponent",
  total_runs,
  batting_average
FROM PlayerAverages
WHERE batting_average >= (
  SELECT batting_average
  FROM PlayerAverages
  ORDER BY batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
ORDER BY batting_average DESC;

WITH WicketCounts AS (

), TopBowlers AS (

    "bowler_id"

)

  AND T1."ball_number" = 1
  AND T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL

  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls_faced,

FROM Deliveries AS T1

ORDER BY

query:
WITH InningProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FourthWicketFall AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_runs" AS score_at_4_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS rn
    FROM InningProgress
    WHERE
      "cumulative_wickets" = 4
  )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), FinalScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS final_score
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T1."batting_team",
  T1."score_at_4_wickets",
  T2."final_score"
FROM FourthWicketFall AS T1
JOIN FinalScores AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
WHERE
  T1."score_at_4_wickets" < 15 AND T2."final_score" >= 140;

query:
WITH FullInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE
        WHEN "batting_team" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad')
        THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
        ELSE "batting_team"
      END
    ) = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  HAVING
    MAX("over_number") >= 19
), PowerplayStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS score,
    COUNT("player_out_id") AS wickets
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" <= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2.score,
  T2.wickets,
  T1.city,
  T1.season AS year
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN PowerplayStats AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
INNER JOIN FullInnings AS T3
  ON T2.match_id = T3.match_id
  AND T2.inning = T3.inning
ORDER BY
  T2.score ASC
LIMIT 5;

query:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    T1.over_number,
    T1.ball_number,
    MIN(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p1_id,
    MAX(T1.striker_id, T1.non_striker_id) AS p2_id,
    T1.runs_scored + T1.extra_runs AS total_runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (
      T2.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T2.team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      T2.team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND T2.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians'
    )
), PartnershipChange AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN p1_id != LAG(p1_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) OR p2_id != LAG(p2_id, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number)
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_partnership
  FROM PartnershipDetails
), PartnershipGroup AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) AS partnership_id
  FROM PartnershipChange
)
SELECT
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name,
  SUM(T3.total_runs) AS partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipGroup AS T3
INNER JOIN Players AS T4
  ON T3.p1_id = T4.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T5
  ON T3.p2_id = T5.player_id
GROUP BY
  T3.match_id,
  T3.inning,
  T3.partnership_id,
  T4.player_name,
  T5.player_name
HAVING
  partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  partnership_runs DESC;

SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  COUNT(T1."striker_id") AS "fifty_plus_count"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "bowling_team" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id"

GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "fifty_plus_count" DESC
LIMIT 4;
